description: Permissoes minimas do nucleo do Tauri para a janela principal do LearnVault desktop. Deny-by-default: alem do conjunto padrao do nucleo (app, event, window, webview, menu, tray, image, resources, path) so os dois comandos IPC app-defined desta fatia (desktop_config e desktop_catalog) sao concedidos. Sem shell, process, http, fs amplo, remote ou updater.
